name: sprite-forge-desktop
_comment: @tauri-apps/cli is pinned EXACTLY, and to the same version magma-ops-app pins. app/kit/bridge-core.js subscribes to events through transformCallback, a Tauri internal, so the shape must not shift under a patch bump — and both apps now ride the one copy of that code. This note sits at the top level and NOT inside devDependencies: npm reads every key in there as a package name, and `npm ci` rejects one starting with an underscore, which is a red release build rather than a local annoyance.
